description: System initialized, waiting for task to begin
Retrieves necessary items (saucepan, mug, milk, tea, sugar, sieve, spoon) to working area
Pours milk from the flask/jug into the saucepan (milk is the boiling base)
Optionally adds a little water to the saucepan
Places the saucepan on the gas stove
Lights the gas stove (e.g. with a lighter) under the saucepan
Heats the milk until it begins to boil
Adds ground tea leaves or a tea bag into the heating milk
Lets the milk tea simmer / steep over low heat
Adjusts the stove heat to control the boil
Stirs the milk tea in the pot to mix tea and sugar
Turns off the stove once the tea is brewed
Positions the fine-mesh sieve over the mug
Strains the brewed tea through the sieve into the mug
Returns unused items to storage and discards spent tea leaves
